caption: The drawing depicts a pair of flat, pointed-toe shoes with low heels. The shoes are positioned side by side, with the left shoe slightly overlapping the right. Both shoes are colored in soft pink, and their surfaces are covered with a black criss-cross net-like pattern. They have light blue laces tied into bows at the front, near the toes. The shoes' interiors are shaded in light gray and white. A small, oval label is depicted on the lower left corner of the image, with handwritten script that includes the words “Mrs. Aldridge, Maker, No. 133, Angel Street.” The background is plain and off-white, with a faint shadow beneath the shoes indicating a light source from above left.
title: Woman's Slipper
